implementation.serialized_enum_consistency: OptionKind, OptionPhase, OptionOutcome, Role and StagePhase statically compared to ROS IDL constants
admission: schema revision 2 and typed goal/context validation
unique action and option instance identities; identities are not rebound
role, stage, clock epoch, localization epoch, map and topology must match
deadline is strictly future and cannot exceed stage deadline for movement options
required target and accepted semantic zone are explicit
movement requires active stage, valid stage lease, motion authorization and no safety stop
HOLD_SAFE has no movement target, can be admitted without movement authority, and never authorizes candidates

lifecycle.candidate_authority: false until current path is validated and all invariants pass; revoked before replan, cancel or terminal result
lifecycle.lease_generation: monotonic on accepted option and replan; carried by ExecutionState and MotionCandidate to fence delayed output from an earlier plan
lifecycle.replacement: new goal rejected while prior option is active; old lease revoked on cancel request; replacement admitted only after cancellation acknowledgement or bounded cancellation timeout
lifecycle.cancel_timeout: INTERNAL_ERROR terminal result after immediate lease revocation; delayed candidates remain inadmissible
lifecycle.termination: deadline and stage boundaries are inclusive; effect completion requires EXECUTING phase, matching option_instance_id and non-empty evidence ID

candidate_lease.owner_check: generation and active option_instance_id are both matched

bounded_records.capacity_behavior: fail closed without evicting identity/idempotency records
bounded_records.audit: monotonic causal sequence with observable dropped-record counter

verification.repository_regression_command: $env:PYTHONPATH = 'hsl_core;ros_ws\src\hsl_safety'; python -m pytest hsl_core\tests sim\kinematic ros_ws\src\hsl_interfaces\test ros_ws\src\hsl_safety\test -q

limitations: The pure-core authority is not connected to an ExecuteOption action server, ROS feedback/result publisher or option_executor_node. The pure message-shaped safety adapter validates lease generation and stage/world-version matches, but native ROS transport was not exercised.
No DDS/QoS, stale transient-local delivery, multi-process cancellation or process-crash behavior was tested.
The runtime adapter must construct OptionContext only from coherent, lease-checked MatchState, map/world and safety snapshots; booleans in this pure contract are not authentication.

OptionRegistry covers role, target, zone and generic lifecycle rules. Option-specific effect measurement and tactical selection remain responsibilities for later P5 work; this authority does not infer capture, arrival, LOS or physical success.
The runtime must preserve stage/epoch metadata in ROS ContractHeader and make candidate admission use the same ExecutionLease instance.
No ROS colcon build, MVSim run, physical robot test or G4 rehearsal was performed.
next_work: Implement the ROS action/execution-state adapter with a single publisher and shared lease, then proceed to P5.3 role selection; retain all integration and G4 blockers until independently verified.
